# AWS SAM Reference & Patterns (Simplified)

This knowledge base provides essential AWS SAM templates, resource definitions, and policy patterns for the Serverless Migration project. This is a simplified version focusing on the most commonly used patterns.

## 1. Standard SAM Template Structure

### Header & Globals
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: Serverless application infrastructure

Globals:
  Function:
    # Basic Configuration (Required)
    Runtime: python3.12  # Adjust based on actual code
    Handler: index.handler
    Timeout: 30  # seconds
    MemorySize: 512  # MB
    # Graviton: 20% lower GB-second price; as fast or faster in this project's
    # real-AWS A/B (m2s-mcp-server PERF_OPTIMIZATION_DESIGN.md A.4). Keep
    # x86_64 only when a dependency ships x86-only compiled modules.
    Architectures:
      - arm64
    
    # Environment Variables (Common)
    Environment:
      Variables:
        ENVIRONMENT: !Ref Environment
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO
    
    # Monitoring & Tracing (Recommended)
    Tracing: Active  # Enable X-Ray tracing
    
    # Shared Layers (Optional)
    Layers:
      - !Ref CommonLayer
    
    # Tags (Recommended)
    Tags:
      Project: MyProject
      Environment: !Ref Environment
```

### Parameters
```yaml
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues: [dev, staging, prod]
```

## 2. Resource Patterns

### Lambda Function Pattern
```yaml
{LambdaName}Function:
  Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
  Properties:
    # ========== Required Configuration ==========
    CodeUri: backend/lambdas/{lambda_name}/
    Handler: handler.lambda_handler
    Runtime: python3.12  # python3.12, nodejs22.x, etc.
    
    # ========== Common Configuration ==========
    MemorySize: 512  # 128-10240 MB (affects CPU and cost)
    Timeout: 30  # seconds (max 900)
    
    Description: "Function description"  # Optional but recommended
    
    # Environment Variables
    Environment:
      Variables:
        TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
        BUCKET_NAME: !Ref BucketName
    
    # Shared Code Layers
    Layers:
      - !Ref CommonLayer
    
    # Permission Policies (choose one approach)
    Policies:
      # Approach 1: SAM Policy Templates (Recommended)
      - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
          TableName: !Ref TableName
      
      # Approach 2: Inline Policy (Fine-grained control)
      - Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${BucketName}/*
          
          # AI/ML Services
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - comprehend:DetectSentiment
              - rekognitio

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >
  airline-booking migrated to Event-Driven Serverless Architecture (SAM).
  Shared infrastructure: REST API Gateway with Cognito authorizer +
  GatewayResponses global CORS headers, Cognito User Pool, five DynamoDB
  tables, and the loyalty-points SQS queue with DLQ.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues: [dev, staging, prod]

Globals:
  Function:
    # No Handler here: the real handler file/export is per-function in S3b
    # (blueprint handler values are architect placeholders only).
    Runtime: python3.12
    Timeout: 30
    MemorySize: 512
    # Graviton default per m2s-sam-kb (no x86-only compiled dependency in
    # this app's blueprint).
    Architectures:
      - arm64
    Environment:
      Variables:
        ENVIRONMENT: !Ref Environment
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Resources:
  # ----- API (REST; blueprint api_gateway.api_type = "rest") -----
  # Cors answers the OPTIONS preflight only; every real response (function or
  # gateway-generated) must carry the global middleware headers below —
  # analysis_report.global_middleware[0] (flask-cors CORS(app), app.py:24),
  # digested for the template in blueprint.api_gateway.gateway_responses /
  # cors (D-9, GAP-9, SI-6).
  AirlineBookingApi:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Api
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref Environment
      # blueprint.api_gateway.endpoint_type = REGIONAL
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Type: REGIONAL
      Cors:
        AllowMethods: "'DELETE, GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, PATCH, POST, PUT'"
        AllowHeaders: "'Content-Type, Authorization'"
        AllowOrigin: "'*'"
      Auth:
        DefaultAuthorizer: CognitoAuthorizer
        Authorizers:
          CognitoAuthorizer:
            UserPoolArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      # Gateway-authored 4xx/5xx (authorizer 401, throttling, integration 5xx)
      # carry the same global headers (GM2). UNAUTHORIZED body/status is the
      # API Gateway default {"message":"Unauthorized"} (SI-6: gateway replies
      # with {message}, not the monolith's {error}); the default body is kept
      # as-is and only the headers are added.
      GatewayResponses:
        DEFAULT_4XX:
          ResponseParameters:
            Headers:
              Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              Vary: "'Origin'"
              Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'DELETE, GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, PATCH, POST, PUT'"
              Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type, Authorization'"
        DEFAULT_5XX:
          ResponseParameters:
            Headers:
              Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              Vary: "'Origin'"
              Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'DELETE, GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, PATCH, POST, PUT'"
              Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type, Authorization'"
        UNAUTHORIZED:
          StatusCode: '401'
          ResponseParameters:
            Headers:
              Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              Vary: "'Origin'"
              Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'DELETE, GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, PATCH, POST, PUT'"
              Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type, Authorization'"
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '$context.requestId $context.error.message'

  ApiLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/apigateway/${AirlineBookingApi}
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ----- Auth (blueprint.cognito; SI-6 / D-1 / D-2 / D-3) -----
  # The four /auth endpoints are dropped; clients talk to Cognito directly.
  # Username stays the client-chosen business id (username_is_business_id —
  # NOT aliased to email), so no UsernameAttributes here. email/created_at
  # are standard attributes (not declared in Schema per the kb rule).
  # Admin groups are authorization data living in UserGroupsTable, not
  # Cognito groups (D-3), so no UserPoolGroup resources and no triggers.
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${Environment}-AirlineBookingUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub ${Environment}-airline-booking-client
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      # blueprint.cognito.token_validity: id/access 1h, refresh 30d
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  # ----- Database (blueprint.dynamodb_tables; keys/GSIs copied 1:1) -----
  FlightTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${Environment}-airline-flight
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  BookingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${Environment}-airline-booking
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: customer
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: customer-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: customer
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LoyaltyTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${Environment}-airline-loyalty
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: flag
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: customer-flag-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: customerId
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: flag
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  UserGroupsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${Environment}-airline-user-groups
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: sub
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: sub
          KeyType: HASH
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # PaymentsTable: the monolith's in-process ledger moved to DynamoDB
  # (D-8, SI-8, SI-14). Partition key chargeIdKey is the type-tagged ledger
  # key "<python type name>:<str(chargeId)>"; item stores the raw chargeId.
  # No createdAt attribute (SI-8). No idempotency table anywhere: the loyalty
  # consumer is dedupe-free by design — deterministic PutItem on id=bookingId
  # (SI-9), so no TimeToLiveSpecification applies.
  PaymentsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${Environment}-airline-payments
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: chargeIdKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: chargeIdKey
          KeyType: HASH
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ----- Async (blueprint.sqs_queues; SI-9, D-5) -----
  # bookings-create -> {bookingId, customerId, points} -> loyalty-award-points
  # (consumer wiring and BatchSize 10 live in S3b events).
  LoyaltyPointsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-loyalty-points'
      VisibilityTimeout: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt LoyaltyPointsQueueDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 3

  LoyaltyPointsQueueDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-loyalty-points-dlq'

# No S3 buckets (metadata.has_file_storage = false) and no EventBridge
# rules (blueprint.eventbridge_rules = []) in this application.

# --- SHARED_RESOURCES_METADATA ---
# has_authentication: true
# has_database: true
# has_async_flows: true
# runtime: python3.12
# cognito_user_pool_logical_name: UserPool
# dynamodb_table_logical_names: FlightTable,BookingTable,LoyaltyTable,UserGroupsTable,PaymentsTable
# sqs_queue_logical_names: LoyaltyPointsQueue
# eventbridge_rule_names: NONE
# --- END METADATA ---
